app.name: Nöbetçi
app.title: On-Duty Pharmacy — North Cyprus
app.description: Shows tonight's on-duty pharmacies in Northern Cyprus on a map and in a list.

hours.oncall: Duty {open}–{close} · pharmacist on the phone until {until}

locask.title: Turn on location to sort by distance
locask.body: It works without location too: pick a region below and pharmacies are listed island-wide.

denied.title: Location permission is off
denied.body: Distances can't be shown. Continue by picking a region, or enable the permission in your browser settings.
denied.help: Tap the lock icon in your browser's address bar, allow Location, then reload the page.

empty.title: No on-duty pharmacy in {region}
empty.titleAll: No duty records found for tonight
empty.body: There is no recorded duty for tonight. Widen the filter to check other regions.

error.title: Couldn't load the list
error.body: There may be a connection problem. Tap to try again.

stale.label: Last updated {ago} · {time}
stale.never: Duty data has not been synced yet

detail.oncallNote: On-call: The pharmacy door is closed. The pharmacist answers the phone until {until}; once you confirm your medicine they will tell you where to meet.
detail.source: Duty information is taken from the Kıbrıs Türk Eczacılar Birliği list. Call to confirm before travelling.

foot.confirm: Call the pharmacy to confirm before travelling.
